status: WORKING NON-CANON; static mathematical geometry only
scope: W01 stage 3B: closed conforming spherical patch geometry, not global W02 transport
definition: Canonical shared unit directions, minor arcs, owner-on-left oriented local polygon rings; region and plate IDs are independent of patch IDs
required_checks: octahedron 8 octants sum to 4*pi steradians and Euler V-E+F=2
every edge has opposite uses and every vertex link covers one full turn
plate larger than a hemisphere, whole-sphere plate, disconnected and holed regions
chart changes, cyclic ring starts, patch order and interior subdivisions preserve geography
seams, poles, rotations, interplate reversal and metric radius scaling
missing faces, duplicate ownership, unpaired/T-junction seams and pinches are refused
indexed matches equal exhaustive matches; boundary queries report all owners
explicit stage-3 vertex binding checks and no implicit snapping
immutable return metadata, byte identities, bounds, cancellation and concurrent reads
self-contained compressed snapshots, corrupt data refusal and fresh-process restoration

No forces, plate motion, spherical material transport, new thermal physics or Windows acceptance
